episodes.synopsis: A rash of killings targeting Hotel Moscow prompts a meeting of the major crime lords and suspicion falls on a pair of twin children.
episodes.title: The Vampire Twins Comen

episodes.synopsis: After Rock and Chang trace the twins' origins to Romania, they become engaged in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with the lethal kids.
episodes.title: Bloodsport Fairytale

episodes.synopsis: Gretel takes Eda hostage, demanding a getaway boat for herself and her brother. Meanwhile, Hansel holds off Balalaika's entire team alone.
episodes.title: Swan Song at Dawn

episodes.synopsis: The Florida mafia and various bounty hunters descend on the Church of Violence in pursuit of U.S. counterfeiter Greenback Jane, who wants to join.
episodes.title: Greenback Jane

episodes.synopsis: Eda tries to help Jane evade the bounty hunters, but her plans -- including an escape on the Black Lagoon -- are foiled at virtually every turn.
episodes.title: The Roanapur Freakshow Circus

episodes.synopsis: Dutch and Benny attempt to rescue Jane and the others, and much will be revealed after the chase as they are pursued by the bounty hunters.
episodes.title: Mr. Benny's Good Fortune

episodes.synopsis: Rock and Revy accompany Balalaika to Japan, where they enact -- then endanger -- an assignment to take out one yakuza gang at the behest of another.
episodes.title: Fujiyama Gangsta Paradise

episodes.synopsis: Feuding breaks out between Balalaika and the Washimine gang, and Rock makes a shocking discovery about Yukio, the girl he met at the festival.
episodes.title: The Succession

episodes.synopsis: Yukio is abducted on the day she takes control of the Washimine Group, and Rock pleads with Ginji to let him and Revy help rescue her.
episodes.title: Two Father's Little Soldier Girls

episodes.synopsis: Revy and Ginji try to save Yukio during a battle with Chaka and his men. Later, she takes Rock to task for trying to save her from a life of crime.
episodes.title: The Dark Tower

episodes.synopsis: Balalaika has wiped out much of the Washimine Group, but Yukio has learned something about Hotel Moscow's technique and uses it to her advantage.
episodes.title: Snow White's Payback

episodes.synopsis: Rock tries to force Yukio out of a life of crime, but events beyond his control may cause his well-laid plans for her future to spin out of control.
episodes.title: The Gunslingers
